title: Flux-Balanced Patankar-type Schemes for the Compressible Euler Equations
summary: Positivity preservation of key physical quantities in the context of fluid flows, such as density and internal energy, is an essential property of a numerical scheme as otherwise the solution lacks physical relevance and has a not well-defined equation of state. One time integration technique that is capable of preserving the positivity of quantities for every time step size is the Patankar-trick and its variants.
